name: Nemtly Jobs
author: sapayth

sections.description:
Nemtly Jobs gives your site a complete job board — without the bloated add-on traps.

Run a niche job board, a careers page, or a regional recruitment portal from one clean plugin. Job seekers search and apply from the front end. Employers post jobs and review applications without ever touching wp-admin. You stay in control with a moderation queue and a setup wizard that gets you live in minutes.

Built for job seekers

  • Search jobs by keyword, location, category, type, and salary range — without a page reload
  • Switch between list and grid views
  • Save jobs you like and come back later
  • Apply in seconds with an uploaded or stored resume
  • Subscribe to email alerts that match your search

Built for employers

  • Post jobs from a guided front-end form with preview before publishing
  • Get your own company profile page — logo, cover image, description, social links
  • Manage applications from a clean front-end dashboard
  • Mark jobs filled, edit, or delete without admin access
  • Get notified by email when someone applies

Built for site owners

  • Two deployment modes — single-employer career page or multi-tenant marketplace
  • Optional moderation queue with one-click approve and reject
  • Auto-expiring listings on a schedule you choose
  • Google Jobs structured data on every job page
  • Pay transparency fields with min/max salary validation
  • Works with shortcodes and Gutenberg blocks
  • Translation-ready, accessibility-minded, mobile-first

Developer-friendly

  • REST API for jobs, applications, resumes, alerts, and settings
  • Theme-overridable PHP templates
  • Action and filter hooks at every meaningful event
  • Custom post types, custom roles, and custom capabilities
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nemtly-jobs folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install through Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Follow the setup wizard to choose your deployment mode and create the required pages.
  4. Visit your new job board.
sections.faq:
Does this work with my theme?

Yes. Nemtly Jobs ships its own scoped styles so it looks consistent across themes without forcing you to write custom CSS.

Can I post jobs from the front end?

Yes. Employers register, build a company profile, and submit jobs through a guided front-end form. They never need wp-admin access.

Does it support Gutenberg?

Yes. Every shortcode has a matching Gutenberg block, so you can drop the job board, dashboards, and submission form into any block-edited page.

Does it work for a single-company careers page?

Yes. The setup wizard offers two modes: a single-employer Career Page mode and a multi-tenant Job Marketplace mode. You can switch later.

Will my jobs show up in Google?

Each job page includes Google Jobs structured data (JobPosting JSON-LD) generated from the fields you fill in.

Is the data safe if I uninstall?

By default, uninstalling leaves your data in place. You can opt in to full data removal in the plugin settings before uninstalling.

Where are resumes stored?

Resumes are stored outside the public media library, in a private directory protected from direct web access. Only the candidate, the employer who posted the job, and admins can download them.
